title: CTAB genomic DNA extraction from Arabidopsis leaf material
author: Diep R R Ganguly

steps.title: Prepare 2 % CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Make 2 % CTAB buffer containing 2 % (w/v) hexadecyltrimethylammonium bromide, 1.4 M NaCl, 20 mM EDTA (pH 8), and 100 mM Tris‑Cl (pH 8).

steps.title: Heat CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Aliquot the required volume of CTAB buffer and heat it in a water bath at 60 °C for 5–10 minutes immediately before use.

steps.title: Cool CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Allow the heated CTAB buffer to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Add CTAB buffer to leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of CTAB buffer for every 100 mg of ground Arabidopsis leaf tissue.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add RNase A solution to achieve a final concentration of 50–100 µg/mL.

steps.title: Mix sample thoroughly
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube briefly and then invert the samples by hand to ensure that all ground tissue is fully suspended in the solution.

steps.title: Incubate at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture in a water bath at 60 °C for 30–60 minutes, mixing the tubes periodically by inversion.

steps.title: Add chloroform and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL chloroform to each tube and mix thoroughly by vortexing or vigorous shaking for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 10 minutes at 20,000 rcf.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase (approximately 200 µL) to a clean tube.

steps.title: Repeat CTAB addition for cleaner extract
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of CTAB buffer (300 µL per 100 mg leaf tissue) to obtain a cleaner extract.

steps.title: Add ice‑cold 2‑propanol
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of ice‑cold 2‑propanol to the aqueous phase and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Incubate at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at –20 °C for 30–60 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 15 minutes at 20,000 rcf.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with 1 mL of 70 % ethanol, mixing by inversion.

steps.title: Centrifuge wash step
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 5 minutes at 9,200 rcf.

steps.title: Remove ethanol and air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Remove as much ethanol as possible using a pipette, then allow the pellet to air‑dry for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the genomic DNA in nuclease‑free water or low‑EDTA TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑Cl, pH 8, 0.1 mM EDTA).

steps.title: Assess DNA yield and purity
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity with a Nanodrop spectrophotometer and evaluate integrity by running samples on a 1 % agarose gel.
